articles.summary: UDR, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: UDR), a leading multifamily real estate investment trust, today announced the publication of the Company’s eighth annual Corporate Responsibility Report, which can be accessed on the Company’s investor relations website at ir.udr.com and on its Corporate Responsibility website at https://www.udr.com/corporate-responsibility/ . articles.title: UDR, Inc. Publishes Eighth Annual Corporate Responsibility Report
